## Entry — 2026-04-14 09:47  (clarification)
classification: binding
touches: requirement, lot
content: |
  Q1 — GI Pipes, Lot 3, Part 3: should the wall thickness of the fittings match the wall thickness
  of the pipes, or is a different thickness acceptable for the fittings?
  A1 — For the GI fittings (Lot 3, Part 3, form C, Item 3.2 of the additional technical requirements):
  compliance is judged against the specified tender requirements — required fitting type and size,
  compliance with BS EN 10242 or equivalent, compatibility with the specified Medium Class GI pipes,
  pressure rating equal to or greater than the pipe, and all other stated technical requirements.

  Q2 — HDPE Pipes, Lot 1, Item 3, Point 3.5 (Steel Backing Flange): bidder offered PP-coated backing
  flanges instead of galvanized mild steel, arguing better durability/corrosion resistance.
  A2 — The offered backing flanges shall meet the specified technical requirements.

## Entry — 2026-04-09 09:51  (clarification)
classification: binding
touches: requirement, lot
content: |
  Q1 — May a bidder participate in only one or two subprojects within a lot, rather than quoting the
  whole lot?
  A1 — Per the tender particulars in eSourcing: bidders may quote for one or more lots, but must offer
  100% of the items and 100% of the quantities specified for each item of a lot. Evaluation is per lot.

classification: binding
touches: requirement
content: |
  Q1 — Do prices include flanges, gaskets, and mounting screws required before/after the valve?
  A1 — Prices shall be submitted per the RFQ requirements and cover the full scope of supply per the
  technical specifications.

  Q2 — On the HDPE Butt Fusion Welding Machine: the specified minimum heater-plate temperature of 280°C
  appears higher than necessary; would a max 270°C heater plate be acceptable?
  A2 — This question is relevant to another RFQ, not to this tender.

  Q3 — Request for a one-month extension due to war-driven raw-material price surges (HDPE up 60–70%).
  A3 — No more extension can be granted.
